create_DensePoseBaseSampler: create a DensePoseBaseSampler instance with a custom count_per_class value for sampling DensePose predictions
call_DensePoseBaseSampler: call the DensePoseBaseSampler on Instances to convert DensePose predictions into a DensePoseList of annotations
sample_DensePoseDataRelative: sample DensePoseDataRelative from estimation results using the _sample method with an instance and bounding box
produce_labels_and_results: produce segmentation labels and stacked UV results from a DensePoseChartPredictorOutput instance
resample_mask: resample coarse and fine segmentation outputs into a 256x256 int64 mask using _resample_mask
